default_view: Today with private For you; Companies, Macro and Compare; optional local positions and company research notes; expanded tools retained
chat: Public deterministic dashboard answers and verified actions; personal state excluded from remote planning/rephrasing
shared_rephrasing: optional; Cloudflare Worker with free-tier providers, each answer checked against dashboard facts
price_feed: Yahoo Finance stream for up to 100 prioritized active names; one connection. Finnhub shared within-budget 120-second fallback, then the timestamped shared snapshot. Full-index breadth uses one adequately covered dated session, not an unqualified all-index tick claim.

python.scope: Python, root tests and public data unchanged; final JavaScript covered by current suites

verification.limits: Controlled automated phone/desktop contexts and screenshot review; manual CUA, physical devices, live provider availability and open-market cadence unobserved. Private state stays in this browser/origin without cloud sync. Prior-close dates absent in current real quotes, so dollar change is withheld.

screener_scores: dated 2026-07-25 snapshot; separate from refreshed prices and fundamentals
notes: Generic customizable investor product. Saved companies do not imply ownership or equal weights. Positions are optional supported long USD equities and remain browser/origin-local.
No cloud or phone synchronization of private positions, notes or review checkpoints. No broker-reconciled balance, transaction accounting, portfolio forecast or personal remote-chat service.

Canonical source timestamps, coverage, dated attribution and historical model limitations remain explicit. Session dollar totals require dated prior regular-close bases and coherent sessions; missing data is never treated as zero.
Controlled phone/desktop and injected quote measurements are recorded separately from open-market cadence, real-device keyboard and client comprehension, which remain unobserved.
Current public data observations retain their original periods; publishing this interface does not restamp quotes, statements or model fits as fresh.
Parent metadata commit is above tested source identity. Exact UI/public payload hashes use canonical Git blob bytes; dynamic quote refresh remains independent.
quote_return_basis: Daily changes use the previous regular-session close. Yahoo extended-session changes are retained separately; an unknown daily reference stays unavailable.
